RUN4SUDAN · EST. CALGARY

MORE THAN A RUN

Movement with
meaning.

Run4Sudan is a community-led initiative bringing people together to raise awareness and support humanitarian relief in Sudan.

What started as an idea to turn solidarity into action has grown into a gathering of runners, families, volunteers, local businesses and supporters. Every step is a reminder of what we can do when we move together.

THE RUN

Every step
tells a story.

A 5K run. An accessible 1K walk. A kids race. One big community.

Our inaugural Run4Sudan brought together more than 600 participants for a day of movement, connection and collective impact in Calgary. From first-time runners to families cheering from the sidelines, everyone had a place at the start line.
